sents.t: On Christmas morning, we decided to call our families.
Lily’s parents live in Seattle, and they were thrilled.
Her dad couldn’t stop asking about the date.
Then I called my mom.
The whole family was at her house.
When I showed them Lily’s ring, my mom started crying, my sister started screaming, and my uncle began singing an old wedding song.
Lily didn’t understand a word, but she started dancing in the kitchen.
“When can we meet her?” my mom asked.
“In the summer,” I promised.
“We’re planning to visit together.”
At noon, we went to Rosa’s house for Christmas lunch.
Rosa had invited everyone: Danny’s family, Carlos and Ana, Emma, Mr. Lee, and even Mr. Brooks.
Before eating, Danny stood up to make a toast.
“To Sam and Lily,” he said.
“Sam, when you arrived, you were afraid to answer the phone. Now look at you!”
Everyone laughed.
Then Mia asked, “Can I be the flower girl?” And Leo asked if Max could be the ring bearer.
“Max is not allowed to hold rings anymore,” Rosa said seriously, and everyone laughed again.
After lunch, Lily and I talked about having a small wedding in the spring, in Rosa’s backyard.
I can’t wait to marry my best friend.
